description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. R. A. G. Ranasinha as a member of the Maharagama U/C
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Maharagama Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for declaring a new member elected due to a resignation, which falls under the category of electoral processes and related matters.
